text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, that is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello. Out together, the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um... well... er...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, do you have a moment? Would 
you care to join me for some tea?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—We have just now returned from the 
hospital.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was just checking on the progress of an 
injury.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see. Is everything progressing smoothly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She is recovering. However... her return 
is expected to take quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"When I asked when I'd be able to race 
again, they told me they didn't know..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Panicking won't do any good. For now, I'll 
prioritize recovery, and I will definitely 
return to the turf one day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Though maybe no one's actually waiting 
for me, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
!? What are you saying?! There's no way 
that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Still... with me not running in races, 
just how many people even remember my 
name...?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more time passes, the more forgotten 
I'll become...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I will, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"If only I, who competed against you both 
in the Classic Triple Crown, kept on 
running—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Each time, the crowd will surely be 
reminded of both of your runs!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will protect the place both of you 
return to! I'll keep your memories alive 
with my running!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how dependable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now we can focus on treatment with peace 
of mind too. Right, Chiyono O-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm sorry for saying something so 
pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got! Please 
wait for me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I'll be waiting for you.

Today is the Arima Kinen. Although she 
withdrew from the race, we came to 
spectate at Yaeno Muteki's request.

A massive crowd had packed into Nakayama 
Racecourse, eager to witness the showdown 
between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross!! Let the "White Lightning" 
roar again today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Oguri!!" his

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo! You're the strongest!! Don't you 
go givin' that up to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Show them your true strength! Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is that Oguri Cap?! It's Oguri Cap! It is 
Oguri Cap!!
(Woooooaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri won...!
(WOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Oguri Cap-san! Could you 
share your thoughts with us right now?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
How do I feel right now...? I'm happy I 
beat Tama.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
How was your showdown with Tamamo 
Cross-san?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated when I lost to Tama at 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). But today, I won.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You beat Tamamo Cross! You're the 
strongest, Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We're counting on you to lead our 
generation, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"With today's victory, some are saying 
that the title of 'The Strongest' has been 
passed to Oguri Cap!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap-san has achieved great feats as 
a representative of the current Classic 
generation!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...The representative of our generation...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...Oguri-san is beyond doubt a formidable 
powerhouse.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(However, the one who contested the 
Classic Triple Crown was—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap rivals Tamamo Cross in both 
popularity and ability. She's sure to 
bring excitement to next year's Twinkle 
Series!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's a rival recognized by Tamamo 
herself, so 'course she is!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about the current Classic 
generation, Super Creek's looking very 
promising too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Man, Oguri's in a league of her own! I 
can't wait to see just how many G1s she's 
gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Why does my name not come up...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Is there no one who would name that 
fierce battle... the Nippon Derby?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let you!! Not in this Derby, 
absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't yield, I won't yield!! I'm going 
to win for Maruzen-san's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!! Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter into 
pieces!! I will burn up this very life and 
carve proof that I existed right here and 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo!! *I'm* going to win the 
Derby! Meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ORRAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O's all-out, desperate run!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ardan-san's resolve to bet it all!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(My fierce sprint, biting right at their 
heels!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Even now, it's burned vividly into my 
mind and makes my heart tremble!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Though maybe no one's actually waiting 
for me, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...How many people out there still 
remember my name, even though I'm no 
longer racing...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more time passes, the more forgotten 
I'll become...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Why must Chiyono O-san and the others 
have to fear that they might have no place 
to return to?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I, who ran with both of you, am right 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who will carry the Classic 
Class generation!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Ogriii!! Look over hereee!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap! Keep giving it your all next 
year, too!
(WAAAH! WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...If that is so... then I will...!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh, aaaaaaaaaaahh!!

Yaeno Muteki lets out a roar. A furious 
bellow fierce enough to trample the 
heavens themselves. Nearby spectators turn 
around in surprise, but—

Her furious scream was drowned out by the 
jubilant cheers celebrating the two 
Umamusume...

For now, I pulled Yaeno Muteki along and 
moved over to the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, hear my words!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My objective is to defeat Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Word on the street is that Oguri-san is 
the strongest of all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall triumph over Oguri-san 
and prove my strength once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've defeated Oguri-san, the 
world will no longer be able to ignore me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then they will surely remember! That we 
were the ones who ran the Classic Triple 
Crown races, and that we are the ones who 
carry this generation!

Yaeno Muteki rattled that off in one 
breath, with a blazing, fiery rage 
radiating from her entire body.

She is completely beside herself with 
rage. Yet, what that furious passion seeks 
is—

"I want to beat Oguri Cap." It was an 
"obsession" so fierce, it felt like a 
raging storm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-dono! I would like to hear 
your opinion!

I simply present the conclusion to Yaeno 
Muteki, knowing she is currently in no 
state to make a calm judgment.

It was a goal she desired so intensely 
that it became an obsession. I'll gladly 
give her my full support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Just as I had hoped! How delightful!!"
